SaffronCity_Gym_Text_AmandaIntro.en: NOX is far younger than I,\nbut he has earned my respect.
SaffronCity_Gym_Text_AmandaIntro.fr: NOX est bien plus jeune que moi,\nmais il a gagné mon respect.

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_AmandaPostBattle.en: In a battle of equals, the one\nwith the stronger will wins.\pIf you wish to beat NOX, focus\nand will yourself to victory.
SaffronCity_Gym_Text_AmandaPostBattle.fr: Dans un combat entre égaux, celui\nqui a la volonté la plus forte\lgagne.\pSi tu veux battre NOX,\nconcentre-toi et impose ta volonté\lde victoire.

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_BagFullOfOtherItems.en: Your BAG is full of other items.

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_CameronIntro.en: NOX is young, but he's also\nour highly skilled LEADER.\pYou won't reach him easily!
SaffronCity_Gym_Text_CameronIntro.fr: NOX est jeune, mais c'est aussi\nnotre CHAMPION très compétent.\pTu l'atteindras pas facilement !

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_CameronPostBattle.en:
There used to be two POKéMON GYMS
in HEMATOWN.\pThe FIGHTING DOJO next door lost
its GYM status, though.\pWe simply creamed them when we
decided to have just one GYM.
SaffronCity_Gym_Text_CameronPostBattle.fr:
Il y avait deux ARÈNES POKéMON à
HEMATOWN.\pLe DOJO DE COMBAT d'à côté a perdu
son statut d'ARÈNE, mais.\pOn les a écrasés quand on a décidé
de n'avoir qu'une seule ARÈNE.

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_ExplainMarshBadgeTa.en: The HEMATITE BADGE makes your\nPOKéMON obey up to Lv. 70.\pIt also lets you use ROCK SMASH\noutside of battle, if you carry\pthe HM.\pTake this too.
SaffronCity_Gym_Text_ExplainMarshBadgeTa.fr: Le BADGE HÉMATITE fait obéir tes\nPOKéMON jusqu'au Niv. 70.\pIl te permet aussi d'utiliser ÉCLAT\nROCHE hors combat, si t'as la CS.\pPrends ceci aussi.

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM04.en: TM46 contains THIEF.\pIt snatches the foe's item. That\nis rude. But effective.
SaffronCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM04.fr: La CT46 contient LARCIN.\pElle vole l'objet de l'ennemi.\nC'est impoli. Mais efficace.

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice.en:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pNOX's POKéMON use psychic
power instead of force.\pFIGHTING POKéMON are especially
weak against PSYCHIC POKéMON.\pThey'll get destroyed before they
can even aim a punch!
SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice.fr:
Yo ! Futur champion !\pLes POKéMON de NOX utilisent la
puissance psychique plutôt que la\lforce.\pLes POKéMON COMBAT sont
particulièrement faibles contre les\lPOKéMON PSY.\pIls seront détruits avant même de
pouvoir viser un coup de poing !

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory.en: Psychic power, huh?\pIf I had that, I'd make a bundle\nat the slots!
SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory.fr: La puissance psychique, hein ?\pSi je l'avais, je ferais fortune\naux machines à sous !

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_JohanIntro.en: Does our unseen power scare you?

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_JohanPostBattle.en: PSYCHIC POKéMON fear only ghosts\nand bugs!
SaffronCity_Gym_Text_JohanPostBattle.fr: Les POKéMON PSY craignent les\nINSECTES et les SPECTRES !

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PrestonIntro.en: HEMATOWN POKéMON GYM is famous for\ntraining psychics.\pYou want to see NOX, don't\nyou? I can tell!
SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PrestonIntro.fr: L'ARÈNE POKéMON d'HEMATOWN est\ncélèbre pour former des psychiques.\pTu veux voir NOX, pas vrai ?\nJe le sens !

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PrestonPostBattle.en: That's right! I used telepathy to\nread your mind!
SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PrestonPostBattle.fr: J'ai lu dans ton esprit ! C'est pas\ntrès clair dedans !

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaBusy.en: NOX: Not now, child.\pThree of the strongest trainers\nwent into the tower.\pWait for them to come back,\nor not. Then we talk.
SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaBusy.fr: NOX : Pas maintenant, enfant.\pTrois des plus forts dresseurs sont\nentrés dans la tour.\pAttends qu'ils reviennent, ou pas.\nEnsuite on parlera.

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaDefeat.en: So you can fight what you cannot\nsee.\pTake the HEMATITE BADGE.
SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaDefeat.fr: Alors tu sais combattre ce que tu\nvois pas.\pPrends le BADGE HÉMATITE.

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaIntro.en:
You find your way here in the
dark, challenger. Good.\pI am NOX. HEMATOWN never sees the
sun, and neither do my DARK\pPOKéMON.\pThey hide, they steal, they
strike where you do not look. Let\pme show you!
SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaIntro.fr:
T'as trouvé ton chemin ici dans le
noir, challenger. Bien.\pJe suis NOX. HEMATOWN voit
jamais le soleil, et mes POKéMON\pTÉNÈBRES non plus.\pIls se cachent, ils volent, ils
frappent là où tu regardes pas.\pLaisse-moi te montrer !

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaPostBattle.en: Light fades when too many people\nwant it.\pThere is one more LEADER before\nthe road ends. And a certain wish\pstill floating out there.
SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaPostBattle.fr: La lumière faiblit quand trop de\ngens la désirent.\pIl reste un CHAMPION avant la fin\nde la route. Et un certain vœu qui\lflotte encore par là.

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaRebel1.en: NOX: I saw you in a dream: a crown\nwith six gems. I did not see how it\lends.\pLet us find out together.
SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaRebel1.fr: NOX : Je t'ai vu dans un rêve : une\ncouronne à six gemmes. J'ai pas\lvu comment ça finit.\pDécouvrons-le ensemble.

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaRebel2.en: The dream breaks.\nThe morning is yours.
SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaRebel2.fr: Le rêve se brise.\nLe matin est à toi.

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaRebel3.en: NOX: Dreams can lie. I do not think\nyours does. Take this.
SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaRebel3.fr: NOX : Les rêves peuvent mentir. Je\nne crois pas que le tien le fasse.\pPrends ceci.

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaVisit1.en: NOX: I saw the wish in my dreams.\nYou chose well. Take this.
SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaVisit1.fr: NOX : J'ai vu le vœu dans mes\nrêves. T'as bien choisi. Prends\lceci.

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaVisit2.en: NOX: A silent world. I like it.\nTake these, you earned them.
SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaVisit2.fr: NOX : Un monde silencieux. J'aime\nça. Prends ça, tu l'as mérité.

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaVisit3.en: NOX: I foresaw the six. Control\nthem or they will control you.
SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaVisit3.fr: NOX : J'avais prévu les six.\nMaîtrise-les, ou elles te\lmaîtriseront.

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_StacyIntro.en: POKéMON take on the appearance of\ntheir TRAINERS.\pYour POKéMON must be tough, then!
SaffronCity_Gym_Text_StacyIntro.fr: Les POKéMON prennent l'apparence de\nleurs DRESSEURS.\pTes POKéMON doivent donc être\ncoriaces !

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_StacyPostBattle.en: I have much to learn still…\pI must master PSYCHIC and teach it\nto my POKéMON…
SaffronCity_Gym_Text_StacyPostBattle.fr: J'ai encore beaucoup à apprendre…\pJe dois maîtriser PSYKO et\nl'enseigner à mes POKéMON.

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_StoneGift.en:
NOX: The HEMATITE is gone. He
took it before I could hide it.\pBut you have the others. He needs
them all. Make him wait.\pGo back to GRENALUX and SURF south
along ROUTE 21. A city of lightning\pwaits there. The old road by
PARMANIE is under fire now.
SaffronCity_Gym_Text_StoneGift.fr:
NOX : L'HÉMATITE a disparu. Il l'a
prise avant que je puisse la\lcacher.\pMais t'as les autres. Il les lui
faut toutes. Fais-le attendre.\pRetourne à GRENALUX et SURFE vers
le sud le long de la ROUTE 21. Une\lville d'éclairs t'y attend. La
vieille route d'AMETHIOLITE est sous\lle feu maintenant.

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TashaIntro.en: You and I, our POKéMON shall\nbattle!
SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TashaIntro.fr: Toi et moi, nos POKéMON vont\ns'affronter !

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TashaPostBattle.en: I knew that this was going to take\nplace.
SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TashaPostBattle.fr: J'avais prévu ce qui s'est passé.

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TyronIntro.en: You understand, don't you?\pThat power alone isn't enough to\nwin in the world of POKéMON?
SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TyronIntro.fr: Tu comprends, pas vrai ?\pQue la puissance seule suffit\npas pour gagner dans le monde des\lPOKéMON ?

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TyronPostBattle.en: NOX just wiped out the KARATE\nMASTER next door.
SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TyronPostBattle.fr: NOX vient de balayer le MAÎTRE\nKARATÉ d'à côté.
